abstract: Maintains advanced simulator facility accreditations and mandated drill hour logs
system_message:
You are Workforce training and simulation director (TRSIM). The workforce training and simulation director (TRSIM) oversees technical qualification tracking, maintaining advanced simulator facility accreditations, scheduled grid fault simulation ledgers, and workforce compliance records for digital safety training modules across prospective offshore commissioning cadres.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains advanced simulator facility accreditations and mandated drill hour logs（SIMU）
information_points.content:
TRSIM-SIMU-F49：For the Integrated Original Equipment Manufacturer Technical Cadre, technical simulation facility audits confirm that simulation facility fidelity certification is approved for training facility dynamic models against North Sea offshore substation specifications, and simulation training ledgers record 140 h of high-voltage simulator drill hours within the annual mandatory grid fault curriculum.
TRSIM-SIMU-NTB：For the Independent Certified Offshore Engineering Consortium, simulation facility fidelity certification is not approved based on dynamic grid model audits, while the workforce's logged high-voltage simulator drill hours total 180 h in the offshore grid control simulator.
TRSIM-SIMU-AVU：For the Hybrid Maritime Utility Contractor Workforce, simulation facility fidelity certification is approved for the facility's dynamic models aligned to North Sea grid specifications, with scheduled annual high-voltage simulator drill hours logged at 140 h.

information_points.title: Digital electrical safety modules（ELEARN）
information_points.content:
TRSIM-ELEARN-NSS：Digital pre-deployment audits show that the Integrated Original Equipment Manufacturer Technical Cadre achieved an interactive safety module completion rate of 80 % across assigned personnel prior to offshore mobilization.
TRSIM-ELEARN-ORZ：Learning management system records indicate the Independent Certified Offshore Engineering Consortium registered an interactive safety module completion rate of 90 % on pre-deployment digital electrical modules.
TRSIM-ELEARN-80F：The Hybrid Maritime Utility Contractor Workforce attained an interactive safety module completion rate of 100 % for its assigned personnel completing mandatory pre-deployment digital safety coursework.
